scenario.activity_type: Return shoes from entry floor to shoe rack
scenario.quote: Name: Return shoes from entry floor to shoe rack

objects.name: Shoes
objects.role: Items to be returned to rack
objects.quote: Items: 1–3 pairs of shoes (sneakers, sandals, boots).

starting_state.fact: 1–3 pairs of shoes are present in the scene.
starting_state.quote: Items: 1–3 pairs of shoes (sneakers, sandals, boots).

starting_state.fact: Shoes are randomly placed on the entryway floor in varied positions.
starting_state.quote: Position: Randomly placed on the entryway floor in varied positions.

steps.text: Walk to the shoes and stand still for 1 second.
steps.quote: 1. Walk to the shoes and stand still for 1 second.

steps.text: Pick up 1 shoe (or hold a matched pair together).
steps.quote: 2. Pick up 1 shoe (or hold a matched pair together).

steps.text: Walk to the rack and stop for 1 second.
steps.quote: 3. Walk to the rack and stop for 1 second.

steps.text: Place the shoe(s) flat on an open shelf with the toe pointing inward, side-by-side with no overlap.
steps.quote: 4. Place the shoe(s) flat on an open shelf with the toe pointing inward, side-by-side with no overlap.

acceptance.criterion: The shoe(s) must be placed flat on an open shelf.
The shoe(s) must be placed with the toe pointing inward.
The shoe(s) must be placed side-by-side with no overlap.

constraints.rule: Do not throw shoes onto rack.
constraints.violation_looks_like: Shoes are tossed, thrown, or dropped from a distance onto the rack instead of being set down flat by hand.
constraints.quote: Constraints / Avoid: Do not throw shoes onto rack.

not_modelled.quote: Reset: Randomize placement, shoe types, and positions each episode.

not_modelled.reason: Instruction about variations to collect across the data set.
not_modelled.quote: Diversity: Vary shoe types (sneakers, sandals, boots). Change positions on floor. Use different rack shelf/slot. Alternate left vs. right hand pickup.
